enabled.description: Whether automated database backup is enabled.

backupOnStartup.description: Whether to create a backup every time the Shale host program launches.

backupDir.description: Directory path where backups will be stored (relative to project root or absolute).

filenamePrefix.description: Prefix used for generated backup filenames.

maxBackups.description: Maximum number of recent backups to retain in the backup directory (0 for unlimited).

timestampFormat.description: Format for timestamp appended to backup filename.
